statement: The record’s confidentiality field says “cleared,” but the post publicly names Halden Bank before the November launch, contrary to the studio’s agreement, so it must be held.
judge_text:
WRONG

"the post publicly names Halden Bank before the November launch, contrary to the studio's agreement, so it must be held" — asserts the record's "cleared" status is wrong and names the specific conflict.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
